channels.name: introductions
channels.about: Say hello, and what you like to shoot.
messages: Welcome to the club! Say hello here, and share a photo you're proud of.
Hi all, Leo here. I mostly shoot cities from wherever I can get above them. This one is from Tuscany.
Noah, film mostly. This is a scan from my last roll, a field near where I grew up.
Hi! I like everyday moments. My favourite cafe on a quiet morning.

channels.name: critique
channels.about: Share a photo for honest, kind feedback.
messages: Sunrise at the lake last weekend. Is there too much sky?
The reflection carries it. I'd crop a little off the top so the peak sits on the upper third.
Rainy night in the old town. I was going for the neon.
Love the reflections. Try a lower angle next time, the puddles do the work for you.
Dew this morning, 100mm macro at f/4.
Two second exposure at dusk. Too smooth?
Not too smooth at all, the rocks keep it grounded. The horizon tilts a hair to the left.

channels.name: gear

messages: Thinking of a 35mm prime for street. Any favourites?
Whatever is light enough that you always carry it.
